conditional_heartbeat_insert.sql: INSERT INTO "chamber_heartbeat_events" ("id", "chamber_id", "reported_status", "session_id", "occurred_at", "expires_at", "detail_json", "progress_json", "last_error_json", "created_at") SELECT %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "chamber_nodes" WHERE "chamber_id" = %s)

active_claims.prepared_statement: SELECT "project_id", "claim_id", "technology", "condition_hash", "operator", "occurred_at", "expires_at", "session_id" FROM "active_claims" WHERE "project_id" = $1 AND ("occurred_at", "claim_id") < ($2, $3) ORDER BY "occurred_at" DESC, "claim_id" DESC LIMIT $4

coverage.prepared_statement: SELECT "project_id", "technology", "condition_hash", "latest_session_id", "latest_operator", "latest_measured_at", "latest_verdict", "latest_attempt_number", "attempt_count", "distinct_session_count", "distinct_operator_count" FROM "coverage_by_condition_hash" WHERE "project_id" = $1 AND ("technology", "condition_hash") > ($2, $3) ORDER BY "technology", "condition_hash" LIMIT $4
